terms.1.b: Cojam Daily is a prediction game. Every day you answer five questions and earn points: +100P for all five and +50P for each right answer.
terms.2.b: You log in with your email through Privy, a login service. A wallet on the Kaia network is created for you inside the app. Keep your email account safe: whoever can read its codes can log in as you.
terms.3.b: Points are a game score. They have no cash value until you convert them to CT, and they cannot be bought, sold or sent to anyone. A conversion cannot be undone. New accounts can convert from 7 days after joining, within a daily limit.
terms.4.b: Picks, conversions, stakes, claims and withdrawals are transactions on the Kaia blockchain. They are public, and once confirmed they cannot be reversed, by you or by Cojam. Check every address before you send.
terms.5.b: A stake is locked for the period you choose. There is no early exit: once the stake unlocks, you can withdraw the CT with its interest.
terms.6.b: An account can be put on hold when we see abuse, such as one person running many accounts. While an account is on hold some features are paused, and the app shows which.
privacy.1.b: Your email address, your wallet address, the display name you set, your language, your picks, points and ranks, and the invite code that links you to a friend.
privacy.2.b: Privy sends your login code and keeps the wallet that is created for you. Privy's own privacy policy covers what it processes.
privacy.3.b: Your picks and every transaction of your wallet are recorded on the Kaia blockchain. Anyone can see them with your wallet address, and they cannot be deleted.
privacy.4.b: The app keeps a play key and the picks it has not sent yet on this device, so your picks are saved without a signature each time. Logging out removes the play key.
